PY001.title: Shell command execution enabled
PY001.description: A subprocess call enables shell parsing. Confirm whether untrusted data can reach the command.
PY001.remediation: Pass an argument list with shell=False and validate every externally controlled argument.

PY002.title: TLS certificate verification disabled
PY002.description: An outbound request explicitly disables certificate verification.
PY002.remediation: Enable certificate and hostname verification and use an approved CA bundle for private services.

PY003.title: Unsafe YAML loader selected
PY003.description: YAML deserialization uses an unsafe loader that may construct arbitrary Python objects.
PY003.remediation: Use yaml.safe_load or SafeLoader and validate the resulting data against a strict schema.
